## Purpose and runtime

Ghost Pepper is a macOS 14+/Apple Silicon menu-bar application for private, on-device dictation and meeting transcription. It captures microphone/system audio, runs local speech and cleanup models, and stores transcripts, summaries, and knowledge artifacts as local Markdown. Optional integrations can use user-configured cloud credentials.

Primary app entry points are `GhostPepper/GhostPepperApp.swift` and state composition in `GhostPepper/AppState.swift`; the Xcode project is `GhostPepper.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`.

## Application shell, permissions, and interaction

The SwiftUI menu-bar UI coordinates recording, settings, transcripts, model controls, search, and chat. App lifecycle utilities handle relaunch/update behavior. macOS permission boundaries are microphone, Accessibility (global hotkey and synthetic paste), and screen recording for OCR/window capture.

Key paths: `GhostPepper/GhostPepperApp.swift`, `GhostPepper/AppState.swift`, `GhostPepper/PermissionChecker.swift`, `GhostPepper/UI/MenuBarView.swift`.

## Dictation control flow

A global Control-key monitor feeds chord/action handling and creates paste sessions. The recorder captures input audio; after release, the selected transcriber produces text, cleanup normalizes it, and the text paster injects it into the focused external application. Accessibility-based focused-element lookup and optional OCR provide contextual input to cleanup.

Key paths: `GhostPepper/Input/HotkeyMonitor.swift`, `GhostPepper/Input/ChordEngine.swift`, `GhostPepper/Input/TextPaster.swift`, `GhostPepper/Audio/AudioRecorder.swift`, `GhostPepper/Context/FocusedElementLocator.swift`.

## Local transcription subsystem

`RecordingSessionCoordinator` owns recording-to-transcription orchestration. `SpeechTranscriber` selects among WhisperKit, FluidAudio, and MLX Audio implementations; chunked and streaming paths support recorded meetings and low-latency dictation. `ModelManager`/catalog manage downloadable local speech-model inventory and selection.

Key paths: `GhostPepper/Transcription/RecordingSessionCoordinator.swift`, `GhostPepper/Transcription/SpeechTranscriber.swift`, `GhostPepper/Transcription/ChunkedTranscriptionPipeline.swift`, `GhostPepper/Transcription/FluidAudioSpeechSession.swift`, `GhostPepper/Transcription/NemotronStreamingModel.swift`.

## Cleanup and contextual correction

The cleanup manager is an abstraction boundary between deterministic correction and local LLM cleanup. It builds prompts from transcription plus OCR context, tracks learned corrections after paste, and invokes LLM.swift-backed local Qwen models. A standalone probe target isolates model validation/CLI execution.

Key paths: `GhostPepper/Cleanup/TextCleanupManager.swift`, `GhostPepper/Cleanup/LocalLLMCleanupBackend.swift`, `GhostPepper/Cleanup/PostPasteLearningCoordinator.swift`, `CleanupModelProbe/main.swift`.

## Meeting capture, archive, and knowledge generation

Meeting detection identifies active calls; dual-stream capture records microphone and system audio. Transcripts, speaker identity resolution, summaries, and meeting Markdown are persisted locally. The Wiki subsystem chunks meeting content and uses structured local LLM output to generate/reconcile entities and cards; indexing builds searchable archive entries.

Key paths: `GhostPepper/Meeting/MeetingDetector.swift`, `GhostPepper/Audio/DualStreamCapture.swift`, `GhostPepper/Meeting/MeetingMarkdownWriter.swift`, `GhostPepper/Wiki/GeneratedWikiEngine.swift`, `GhostPepper/Indexing/IndexBuilder.swift`.

## Search, QA, and integrations

QA is an agent layer over local meeting/wiki files, with sandboxed file tools and QMD/wiki search. Providers include local LLMs and an optional Anthropic-backed path, with credentials isolated through Keychain. Pepper Chat routes commands to optional Zo and Trello backends; Airtable and Granola importers ingest external meeting data.

Key paths: `GhostPepper/QA/MeetingQAAgent.swift`, `GhostPepper/QA/PathSandbox.swift`, `GhostPepper/QA/AnthropicProvider.swift`, `GhostPepper/PepperChat/PepperChatSession.swift`, `GhostPepper/Meeting/GranolaImporter.swift`.

## Infrastructure and operational boundaries

Inference is local through WhisperKit, FluidAudio, MLX Audio, and LLM.swift; model artifacts are downloaded once from Hugging Face and cached locally. Sparkle-style update metadata is represented by `appcast.xml`; usage and debug data remain local. Signing, entitlement, and privacy constraints are central to macOS deployment.

Key paths: `GhostPepper/ModelInventory.swift`, `GhostPepper/UpdaterController.swift`, `GhostPepper/GhostPepper.entitlements`, `GhostPepper/UsageStats/UsageStatsStore.swift`, `PRIVACY_AUDIT.md`.
